    • findOneWithAuthoritiesByEmailIgnoreCaseForOAuth

      @Query("SELECT u.* FROM jhi_user u WHERE LOWER(u.email) = LOWER(:email)") reactor.core.publisher.Mono<User> findOneWithAuthoritiesByEmailIgnoreCaseForOAuth(String email)
      OAuth user lookup by email. Do not JOIN jhi_user_authority: multiple roles (e.g. ROLE_ADMIN + ROLE_USER) would make Mono fail with non-unique result. Load authorities separately via UserAuthoritiesLoader.
